_comment: Hand-checked verdicts for disagreements listed by tools/divergence_test.py. Read by tools/divergence_report.py to annotate docs/DIVERGENCE.md. verdict: registry_error (registry was wrong, status fixed), library_error (registry verified against the exchange, the reference libraries are wrong) convention_difference (both defensible, sources use different conventions) or unpublished (the exchange or its government has not published that year, so the registry value is a prediction; recheck_date says when to look again). Every entry must cite the exchange's own publication, or for an unpublished year the page where it will appear.

entries.summary: Euronext's calendars for 2025 and 2026 close Amsterdam on Labour Day (May 1) and list Liberation Day, King's Day, Ascension Day, Whit Monday and the Dec 28 2026 substitute (Dublin only) as full trading days. The registry had them the other way round.

The Wiener Boerse lists Good Friday, Dec 24 and Dec 31 as closed (handelsfrei) and Epiphany, Ascension Day, Whit Monday, Corpus Christi, Assumption Day and Immaculate Conception as additional trading days. The registry closed the second group and treated the eves as half days.

The Saudi Exchange announced the 2025 and 2026 Eid holidays by the last trading day and the resumption day. The registry was missing 14 closed weekdays inside those spans, and 2025-06-10 as well (the libraries are also open on it, so it appears below as a library error).

The Saudi Exchange lists Founding Day as Sunday 2025-02-23 (closed), says trading discontinues at the END of 2025-03-27 and 2025-06-04 (both are trading days), and resumes on 2025-04-03 and 2025-06-11, which makes 2025-06-10 a closed day. Both libraries are wrong on all four. This is not a Hijri approximation: they carry the 2026 Eid spans exactly, but start both 2025 spans on the last trading day (2025-03-27, 2025-06-04) and end the 2025 Adha span a day early.

Euronext's calendars for 2025 and 2026 close Brussels on Good Friday, Easter Monday, Labour Day, Christmas Day and (2025) Boxing Day only. Ascension Day, Whit Monday, Belgian National Day, Assumption Day, Armistice Day and the Dec 28 2026 substitute (Dublin only) are full trading days. The registry closed those ten and was missing Good Friday on 2025-04-18 and 2026-04-03.

Euronext's calendars for 2025 and 2026 close Lisbon only on the common Euronext closures; Freedom Day, Portugal Day, Corpus Christi, Assumption Day, Republic Day, Restoration of Independence and Immaculate Conception are full trading days. The registry closed those eleven and was missing Boxing Day on Friday 2025-12-26.

The NSE and BSE 2026 trading-holiday lists close on Thu 2026-01-15 (Maharashtra municipal corporation election), Tue 03-03 (Holi), Thu 03-26 (Ram Navami), Tue 03-31 (Mahavir Jayanti), Thu 05-28 (Bakri Id), Mon 09-14 (Ganesh Chaturthi) and Tue 11-10 (Diwali-Balipratipada). The registry had three of them a day late (Holi 03-04, Bakri Id 05-27, Ganesh Chaturthi 09-15), Balipratipada a day early (11-09), a closure on Fri 03-20 (Id-Ul-Fitr is Saturday 03-21, so it is a weekend day) and was missing the election holiday, Ram Navami and Mahavir Jayanti.

NSE lists Tuesday 2025-10-21 (Diwali Laxmi Pujan) as a trading holiday and runs only a one-hour Muhurat session (13:45-14:45) on it; the next day is Diwali-Balipratipada. The registry keeps the day closed, like the exchange's list and like BSE (XBOM, where both libraries agree). pandas_market_calendars counts the day as open because of the Muhurat session. Both are defensible; no data change.

NYSE announced Christmas Day 2027 observed on Friday 2027-12-24 (closed all day) and no New Year's Day holiday for 2028, because 1 January 2028 is a Saturday. The registry had a Christmas Eve early close on the 24th and a closure on 2027-12-31. The New Year's Day recurrence rule also generated the 31st; it now uses fixed_with_sunday_observance.

NYSE announced Christmas Day 2027 observed on Friday 2027-12-24 (closed all day) and no New Year's Day holiday for 2028, because 1 January 2028 is a Saturday. The registry had a Christmas Eve early close on the 24th and a closure on 2027-12-31. The New Year's Day recurrence rule also generated the 31st; it now uses fixed_with_sunday_observance. Nasdaq follows the NYSE calendar.

New Year's Day 2028 is a Saturday, observed on Monday 3 January; the ASX 24 trading calendar for 2028 lists it closed. The registry had it open. The last business days before Christmas and of the year (2028-12-22 and 2028-12-29) close at 14:10 under the ASX rule and were missing as early closes.

Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve 2028 are Sundays, so the preceding Fridays close at 12:30, as the LSE did on 22 and 29 December 2000 (Stock Exchange Notice N49/00) and 2023. The registry had them as full days (a half-day mismatch, not a trading-day one).

JPX closes 31 December and 1-3 January only, so Monday 2027-01-04 and Friday 2028-12-29 trade. Marine Day is the third Monday of July (2027-07-19, not the 20th). The 2027 autumnal equinox is Thursday 23 September (the registry had the 21st). A Saturday national holiday has no substitute under the Act on National Holidays, so 2029-05-07 trades; the 2029 equinox falls on Sunday 23 September, so Monday 2029-09-24 is the substitute (the equinox date is a prediction until the National Astronomical Observatory publishes it).

The SEHK circular for 2027 (CT/077/26) lists the day following the Mid-Autumn Festival as Thursday 16 September (the registry had the 15th, the festival itself) and Friday 5 February, the eve of Lunar New Year, as a half day (missing). It names 8 and 9 February the third and fourth days of Lunar New Year; the registry names are corrected.

Both libraries stop at 2026 (exchange_calendars holds no 2027 holidays), so the 16 2027 disagreements are an empty reference, not a different date. The SSE publishes its holiday notice for a year in the last weeks of the year before (the newest notice on its list covers 2026), after the State Council sets the public-holiday arrangement. The registry values for 2027 are predictions (confidence note: predicted) and stay as they are until the exchange publishes 2027.

MOM gazetted Hari Raya Puasa 2027 on Wednesday 10 March. The registry had Tuesday 9 March; it now closes 10 March (which appears below as a library error, because the library has no 2027 data).

MOM published the 11 gazetted 2027 public holidays on 2026-06-18: 1 Jan, 6-8 Feb (Chinese New Year; 6 Feb is a Saturday and 7 Feb a Sunday, so Monday 8 Feb is the holiday), 10 Mar, 26 Mar, 1 May (Saturday), 17 May, 20 May, 9 Aug, 28 Oct, 25 Dec (Saturday). The eight weekday closures match the registry exactly. pandas_market_calendars has no 2027 holidays (data ends 2026), so it shows these days open.

MOM has not gazetted the 2028 public holidays (it published 2027 on 2026-06-18), and pandas_market_calendars holds no 2028 data. The registry values are predictions, including the Hari Raya and Deepavali dates, which MOM may move.

MOM has not gazetted the 2029 public holidays (it published 2027 on 2026-06-18), and pandas_market_calendars holds no 2029 data. The registry values are predictions, including the Hari Raya and Deepavali dates, which MOM may move.

The Chilean holiday laws are fixed in advance. Holidays that land on a weekend are not moved (Ley 2.977): 1 May 2027, 15 Aug 2027, 19 Sep 2027, 25 Dec 2027, 1 Jan 2028, 21 May 2028, 16 Jul 2028 and 8 Dec 2029 were wrongly shifted by a generic weekend rule. San Pedro y San Pablo and 12 Oct move to a Monday (Ley 19.668) and 31 Oct to a Friday (Ley 20.299): 28 Jun and 11 Oct 2027, 26 Jun, 9 Oct and 27 Oct 2028, 2 Jul, 15 Oct and 2 Nov 2029. Ley 20.215 adds Monday 17 Sep 2029. All Saints (1 Nov) was missing from the rules, so 1 Nov 2028 and 2029 were open. The three movable holidays are now explicit dates; the rest use fixed_date.
Ley 20.983 makes Friday 17 September a holiday when the 18th and 19th fall on Saturday and Sunday, as in 2027. The registry closes the day; exchange_calendars shows it open.

Bolsa de Santiago has not published its 2027 and 2029 trading schedules. The registry carries the 31 December early close (13:00) it publishes for 2025 and 2026; exchange_calendars closes the day. Neither can be checked until the Bolsa lists the year.

DGPA's 2027 government calendar (published 2026-05-21) observes a Saturday holiday on the previous working day and a Sunday one on the next: Peace Memorial Day (Sunday 28 Feb) is Monday 1 Mar, not Friday 26 Feb; Labour Day (Saturday 1 May) is Friday 30 Apr; National Day (Sunday 10 Oct) is Monday 11 Oct; Taiwan Retrocession Day is Monday 25 Oct; New Year's Day 2028 (Saturday) is observed Friday 31 Dec 2027. The Spring Festival holiday ends Wednesday 10 Feb, so Thursday 11 Feb is a working day. The 2025 Commemoration and Holidays Act made 28 Sep, 25 Oct and 25 Dec national holidays; the registry lacked them from 2027, including the 2028 and 2029 dates, which fall on weekdays.

2027-02-03 is the registry's pre-Chinese-New-Year settlement day. DGPA's calendar starts the holiday on 4 Feb; whether TWSE and the depository also close on the 3rd is announced in TWSE's own yearly schedule, which is not out yet.

DGPA publishes the government calendar for a year by 30 June of the year before (the 2027 one came out on 2026-05-21), and TWSE its own schedule later. The remaining 2028 dates depend on lunar festivals, the Children's Day and Tomb Sweeping adjustment and settlement days, none of which is published. The registry values are predictions.

Independence Day (6 December) was missing from the rules, so 6 Dec 2027, 2028 and 2029 (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday) were open. Midsummer Eve 2027 is Friday 25 June, the Friday before Midsummer Day (Saturday 26 June), not 18 June.

The Public Holidays Act 36 of 1994, s2(1) moves a holiday that falls on a Sunday to the Monday and does nothing for a Saturday. The rules shifted Saturday holidays to the Friday: 16 Dec 2028 and 16 Jun 2029 (the Fridays 15 Dec and 15 Jun were wrongly closed), and also 9 Aug 2025 and 21 Mar 2026. The ten fixed-date holidays now use fixed_with_sunday_observance.

TMX closes on the Monday in lieu of a Saturday holiday and stays open the Friday before (TSX closed Monday 3 January 2022 in lieu of Saturday 1 January 2022). The rules closed Friday 31 Dec 2027 and Friday 30 Jun 2028 and left Monday 3 Jan 2028 open; Canada Day 2028 was already closed on Monday 3 July.
The Matariki public holiday dates are set in law through 2052: Friday 25 June 2027, Friday 14 July 2028, Friday 6 July 2029. The registry had 2 July 2027, 23 June 2028 and 22 June 2029.
